svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.23k stars in total, about 1.78k a year earlier. jactionlint 314, mr boxington 705, aube 2058, fnox 2360, hk 1302, pitchfork 711, usage 1073, +6 more 705.
